project_name: Sistem Intelijen Data Bappeda Kota Makassar
theme: Light mode default (high-contrast for accessibility), with explicit Dark mode toggle support

headings.style: tracking-tight, high-contrast, authoritative, large scales for dashboards

typography.rules: DO NOT use Inter or standard fonts for headings. The hierarchy gap rule applies: jumping between heading and subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.

colors.rules: Avoid pure black (#000000). Always explicitly set text color on hover. Ensure all interactive elements have focus states with higher contrast.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'GRID BORDERS' or flat solid backgrounds with sharp 1px borders to separate regions, avoiding murky shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include subtle noise or minimal patterns to break flat spaces in login/hero sections.

components.general: Shadcn/UI heavily customized for government aesthetic.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select components. High contrast borders required.
components.charts: Recharts (Shadcn chart component). Must include data tables for accessibility.
components.map: Leaflet with OpenStreetMap tiles. High contrast markers for kecamatan.

layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized.
layouts.header: Solid background with hard bottom border. Sticky top.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: use p-6 or p-8 inside cards to avoid text collision.

motion.rules: Minimalist animations. Use micro-interactions for feedback. Entrance animations should stagger. Must respect prefers-reduced-motion.

accessibility.disabilitas_buta: Implement a global Text-to-Speech button (mocked via SpeechSynthesis or API). High contrast UI. Keyboard navigable. Screen reader tags (aria-labels, aria-live).
accessibility.disabilitas_tuli: Ensure all audio/video (if any) has captions. Primarily text and visual-based data representation.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings: focus:ring-4 focus:ring-red-600 focus:outline-none.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

media.images: Use solid colors or patterns primarily. For login/hero, use professional government aesthetic images.

login_hero.description: Silhouette of concrete buildings at sunset, giving a governmental or official skyline feel.

map_placeholder.description: Abstract map showing global data points.
map_placeholder.category: AI analysis background or map placeholder

instructions_to_main_agent: Create a robust Dashboard Layout with Sidebar and Header (JWT mocked auth state).
Develop real-time statistics widgets for poverty, stunting, disability, ATS, and PMKS.
Integrate interactive region mapping of Makassar (mocked data per 15 kecamatan).
Implement an AI Analysis feature (mocked Claude Sonnet 4.6) for program recommendations.
Build a robust Accessibility Panel (toggle for high contrast, large text, and Text-to-Speech readouts).
Include Data Entry forms for kecamatan officers to update statistics.
Ensure UI is strictly in Bahasa Indonesia.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT use Inter or generic sans for headings.
Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Never apply transition: all globally. Add transitions for specific properties.
Do not center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
